final: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.questregistry, s.gbsize, s.spanmin, t.healtheval FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry), grp AS (SELECT healtheval, AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS grp_avg, COUNT(*) AS grp_cnt FROM joined GROUP BY healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg FROM grp), pairs AS (SELECT g.grp_avg, g.grp_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM grp g JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.grp_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(grp_avg), AVG(grp_cnt), AVG(grp_avg - overall_avg) FROM pairs WHERE grp_avg > overall_avg
